validationClasses.question: Is the evaluated object tied to an exact version, path, package, or digest?
Has the implementation been shown to execute its declared mechanics under controlled tests?
Has the implementation been checked against its frozen internal specification or contract?
Has the asset been evaluated against an external standard, benchmark, public dataset, or externally defined reference?
Has a genuinely independent implementation, observer, or reproducer obtained the required result?
Has an independent security reviewer assessed the relevant threat model and implementation?
Where applicable, has empirical evidence established the measurement or scientific claim under a declared validation design?
Has a competent external certification or accreditation body issued the relevant certification or accreditation?
